name: Chicken with sour bamboo
summary: Ma chicken stir-fried with bamboo shoots soured in a salt jar for about two weeks. VnExpress prints a 30 to 45 minute cook. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: VnExpress, Thanh Hằng, 2 Jun 2021, in an article on three Dak Nong specialties.
taste: VnExpress says the sour bamboo smells fragrant once the chicken is soft, and that cooks scatter crushed forest pepper on the plate before eating.
howToEat: Peel the bamboo shoots, slice them thin, and salt them in a covered jar for about two weeks. Squeeze them dry.
Stir them into chicken that has already been seasoned. VnExpress says the Ma cook keeps an even fire so the meat and the shoots soften without burning, about 30 to 45 minutes.
A price is Check on arrival.
where: VnExpress ties the dish to Ma cooking in Dak Nong and does not name a restaurant. A door is Check on arrival. Hours are Check on arrival.
